About us

Your Local Pest & Critter Team

White Flag Pest & Critter is a locally-owned, family-run San Antonio and surrounding area pest and animal control company. We offer almost two decades of experience in pest control services and animal trapping to residential and commercial customers.

From bed bugs, mosquitos, and termites to snakes and bats, we can safely eliminate these unwanted guests from your home or workplace in an efficient, timely manner.
